# qrcodes.win

> A free, privacy-first QR code generator that creates QR codes entirely in your browser — no signup required, and the data you enter never leaves your browser.

## About
QRCodes.win is a free, privacy-first QR code generator. Create QR codes for URLs, text, WiFi, contact cards, and more. The content you enter is never uploaded or stored — QR codes are generated locally in your browser. The site uses Google Analytics for anonymous, aggregate visit statistics only.

## Features / QR Code Types
The main generator (homepage) supports these QR code types via tabs:
- URL — website links
- Text — any plain text
- WiFi — network credentials (SSID, password, security type WPA/WPA2, WEP, or no password)
- Email — mailto links with optional subject and body
- Phone — tel links
- SMS — pre-filled text messages with phone number and body

Customization options:
- QR foreground color and background color (color pickers)
- Size: 200px, 256px, 384px, or 512px
- Error correction level: Low (L), Medium (M), Quartile (Q), High (H)
- Download as PNG or SVG

Specialized generators (dedicated pages with tailored UX) cover:
- WiFi QR Code — share WiFi password instantly
- vCard QR Code — digital business card
- Restaurant Menu QR Code — contactless digital menu
- WhatsApp QR Code — open a WhatsApp chat
- Instagram QR Code — link to a profile
- Location QR Code — Google Maps directions
- App Store QR Code — iOS & Android app downloads
- Google Review QR Code — collect more Google reviews
- PDF QR Code — link to PDF documents

## URL Patterns
- `/` — English homepage / main generator
- `/<type>/` — specialized generators (e.g. `/wifi/`, `/vcard/`, `/menu/`, `/whatsapp/`, `/instagram/`, `/location/`, `/app/`, `/google-review/`, `/pdf/`)
- `/blog/` — blog index
- `/blog/<slug>.html` and `/blog/<slug>/` — individual articles
- `/<lang>/` — localized homepage for each supported language (e.g. `/es/`, `/de/`, `/fr/`)
- `/<lang>/<type>/` — localized specialized generators (e.g. `/es/wifi/`, `/ja/vcard/`)
- `/<lang>/blog/` — localized blog index

## Privacy / How It Works
- All QR code generation happens client-side in the browser using an embedded QRCode.js library (`qrcode.min.js`). No server processing.
- The data you enter (URLs, WiFi passwords, contacts, etc.) never leaves your device and is never seen or stored by the site.
- No signup or account is required; usage is unlimited with no watermarks.
- PNG downloads are produced from the rendered canvas; SVG downloads are reconstructed from canvas pixels — both entirely in-browser.

## Notes
- This is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages (served from the `qrcodes.win` custom domain via CNAME).
- Free to use: no signup, no limits, no watermarks; entered data is never uploaded or stored.
- Privacy-first: QR codes are generated entirely in the browser.
- Not affiliated with any QR code standards body, WhatsApp, Instagram, Google, or Apple.
